1612: +class ScopeCommitFailureTests(unittest.TestCase):
1613: +    @staticmethod
1614: +    def prompt(commander, context=None, output=b""):
1615: +        scope = f" ({context})" if context else ""
1616: +        commander.on_state(FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT, Data(
1617: +            output + f"fw{scope} #".encode()
1618: +        ))
1619: +
1620: +    @staticmethod
1621: +    def writes(terminal):
1622: +        return [call.args[0] for call in terminal.write.call_args_list]
1623: +
1624: +    def test_closing_failure_cannot_be_disabled_or_replayed(self):
1625: +        for close in ("next", "end"):
1626: +            for capture in (False, True):
1627: +                for best_effort in (False, True):
1628: +                    with self.subTest(close=close, capture=capture, best_effort=best_effort):
1629: +                        terminal = MagicMock()
1630: +                        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock(), best_effort)
1631: +                        feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "commit", [
1632: +                            CommandSpec(close, capture_output=capture, fail_on_error=False),
1633: +                            "set must-not-run 1",
1634: +                        ])
1635: +                        feature.on_context_loss = MagicMock()
1636: +                        following = RecordingFeature(commander, "following", ["get status"])
1637: +                        commander.start([feature, following])
1638: +                        self.prompt(commander, "port1")
1639: +                        # The failure code can span multiple serial reads.
1640: +                        for chunk in (b"Command fa", b"il. Return co", b"de -542.\r\n"):
1641: +                            data = Data(chunk)
1642: +                            commander.on_output(data)
1643: +                            self.assertTrue(data.discarded)
1644: +                        if best_effort:
1645: +                            self.prompt(commander, "interface")
1646: +                            self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), [close + "\r", "get status\r"])
1647: +                            self.assertEqual(commander.feature_errors[0][0], "commit")
1648: +                            self.assertIn("return code -542", commander.feature_errors[0][1])
1649: +                        else:
1650: +                            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "return code -542"):
1651: +                                self.prompt(commander, "interface")
1652: +                            self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), [close + "\r"])
1653: +                        feature.on_context_loss.assert_not_called()
1654: +                        self.assertEqual(feature.executed, [])
1655: +                        self.assertFalse(feature.completed)
1656: +
1657: +    def test_closing_failure_with_same_prompt_still_ejects(self):
1658: +        for code in ("0", "7", "-61"):
1659: +            for suffix in ("", "."):
1660: +                with self.subTest(code=code, suffix=suffix):
1661: +                    terminal = MagicMock()
1662: +                    commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock())
1663: +                    feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "commit", ["next", "end"])
1664: +                    commander.start([feature])
1665: +                    self.prompt(commander, "port1")
1666: +                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, f"return code {code}"):
1667: +                        self.prompt(
1668: +                            commander, "port1",
1669: +                            f"  Command fail. Return code {code}{suffix}\r\n".encode(),
1670: +                        )
1671: +                    self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), ["next\r"])
1672: +
1673: +    def test_tolerated_set_failure_does_not_poison_successful_scope_close(self):
1674: +        for capture in (False, True):
1675: +            with self.subTest(capture=capture):
1676: +                terminal = MagicMock()
1677: +                commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock())
1678: +                feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "configure", [
1679: +                    ConfigBlock("system interface", [EditBlock("port1", [
1680: +                        CommandSpec("set unsupported 1", capture_output=capture),
1681: +                    ])]),
1682: +                ])
1683: +                commander.start([feature])
1684: +                self.prompt(commander)
1685: +                self.prompt(commander, "interface")
1686: +                self.prompt(commander, "port1")
1687: +                self.prompt(commander, "port1", b"Command fail. Return code -61.\r\n")
1688: +                self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "next\r")
1689: +                self.prompt(commander, "interface")
1690: +                self.prompt(commander)
1691: +                self.assertTrue(feature.completed)
1692: +                self.assertTrue(commander.ready)
1693: +                self.assertEqual(commander.feature_errors, ())
1694: +
1695: +    def test_cleanup_closing_failure_uses_bootstrap_error_policy(self):
1696: +        for best_effort in (False, True):
1697: +            with self.subTest(best_effort=best_effort):
1698: +                terminal = MagicMock()
1699: +                commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock(), best_effort)
1700: +                feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "work", ["get initial"])
1701: +                following = RecordingFeature(commander, "following", ["get status"])
1702: +                commander.register_cleanup(feature, CleanupAction(
1703: +                    "close", CommandSequence("close", ["end"]),
1704: +                ))
1705: +                commander.start([feature, following])
1706: +                self.prompt(commander)
1707: +                self.prompt(commander)
1708: +                self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "end\r")
1709: +                if best_effort:
1710: +                    self.prompt(commander, output=b"Command fail. Return code -5.\r\n")
1711: +                    self.assertEqual(commander.feature_errors[0][0], "cleanup")
1712: +                    self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal)[-1], "get status\r")
1713: +                else:
1714: +                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "return code -5"):
1715: +                        self.prompt(commander, output=b"Command fail. Return code -5.\r\n")
1716: +                    self.assertNotIn("get status\r", self.writes(terminal))
1717: +
1718: +    def test_unusable_completion_prompt_cannot_enter_best_effort_wait(self):
1719: +        terminal = MagicMock()
1720: +        commander = FOSCommander(terminal, MagicMock(), continue_on_error=True)
1721: +        feature = RecordingFeature(commander, "commit", [CommandSpec(
1722: +            "end", completion_states=(FOSCliState.CONFIRMATION,),
1723: +            expected_completion_state=FOSCliState.CMD_PROMPT,
1724: +        )])
1725: +        commander.start([feature])
1726: +        self.prompt(commander, "interface")
1727: +        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "unexpected prompt"):
1728: +            commander.on_state(FOSCliState.CONFIRMATION, Data(b"Do you want to continue?"))
1729: +        self.assertEqual(self.writes(terminal), ["end\r"])
1730: +        self.assertFalse(feature.completed)
